artistAlley.information: Artist Alley application and information will be provided here.

gettingThere.address: Inner West Pride Centre, 1 Bedford St, Newtown NSW 2042
gettingThere.publicTransport: The venue is only a few minutes walk away from Newtown Station, and is also accessible via buses.
gettingThere.parking: There is paid parking available in Newtown near the venue, and limited street parking.
gettingThere.accessibility: The venue has a lift which can be used to access the market. All artist tables, mirror and clothing racks will be located in the hall. The free activity tables and Mini Lolita Musuem display are on the stage which can be accessed by walking a few stairs but no ramp and therefore is no accessible. Please see AzuriteCon staff for a free activity pack if you cannot access the stage.

faq.question: Where is AzuriteCon?
faq.answer: AzuriteCon will be held at 1 Bedford St, Newtown NSW 2042.

faq.question: When does online ticket sales end?
faq.answer: Online Eventbrite ticket sales end Thursday, 15 April 2027.

faq.question: How much is entry?
faq.answer: Market Entry is $8 plus booking fees online, or $11 on the day. Saturday Market + Panels & Performances is $15 plus booking fees online only. Kids aged 12 years or under are $4 on the day.

faq.question: How do I apply for Artist Alley?
faq.answer: Use the Artist Alley application form linked on the website.
